title: Short-Sale Replacement Appraisal Carry
content:
Replacement and update appraisals — Short-sale replacement appraisal carry (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale replacement appraisal carry enters the short-sale accrual basis. The inputs are read from the loan's maturity case under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product.

*Inputs:* the case's appraisal date; the effective date of its latest granted extension entry, if any; its due-and-payable date; the appraisal ordering period, in calendar days, of the case's plan.

*Judgement:*
1. If the appraisal date falls on or after the latest granted extension's effective date and no more than the ordering period after it, the short-sale replacement appraisal carry is USD 295.00, the update appraisal fee.
2. Otherwise, if the appraisal date is more than the ordering period after the due-and-payable date, the short-sale replacement appraisal carry is USD 395.00, the replacement appraisal fee.
3. Otherwise, and for a case with no appraisal date, nothing is carried (0.00).

*Hypothetical cases* (ordering period taken as 45 days for the illustration): an appraisal 10 days after the latest extension's effective date gives USD 295.00; an appraisal 46 days after that date and 120 days after the due-and-payable date gives USD 395.00; an appraisal 40 days after the due-and-payable date on a case with no extension gives nothing.
